name: title
description: The record reference. Carries the weight in the bar, but is deliberately not a heading.

name: caption
description: What kind of record it is, shown before the reference.

name: meta
description: Supporting detail such as the applicant or the status.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: Appended for screen readers, so repeated actions are distinguishable out of context.

name: container
description: Wraps the contents in `govuk-width-container`, for a bar that spans the full page width.

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible name for the landmark. Defaults to `Current record`.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the bar.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the bar.
